system.description: Immediately after awakening from a dreamtrance, the thaumaturge spends 10 minutes piecing together fragments of her dreams. If she succeeds in a Simple Challenge with the Storyteller, she receives a series of allegorical or symbolic images concerning one upcoming event in her unlife. This power requires the presence of a Storyteller or Narrator to provide results, and requires at least five minutes of dreamlike trance beforehand.
